attributes.name: Dogue de Bordeaux
attributes.description: The Dogue de Bordeaux is a large breed of dog that originated in France. It is a powerful and athletic breed, with a short, smooth coat. Its head is large and round, with small, erect ears. Its legs are strong and muscular, and its tail is usually docked. The Dogue de Bordeaux is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys spending time with its family.
